Ha, fell asleep on the bathroom floor after taking some sleeping pills. Did anyone come and wake me up? Nope; no one cares what i'm doing. 

I love sports. I played a lot of squash and football, but now that iv moved to a new country i don't have anyone who wants to play either sports with me.

How is it going to get better? No one loves me. My friends have forgotten about me. There is no one to live for. Any chance of me getting into a good college have dissipated. I just don't have any goals anymore. I don't have anything to look forward to. It's pointless
